title: Basketball
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael organizes a friendly basketball game between the office and warehouse staff to boost morale. Dwight wants to join the team but is denied and assigned weekend work instead. Michael selects the team lineup, including himself and others, while excluding Phyllis. The game begins with competitive play, some trash talk, and Michael struggling with his performance. Conflicts arise between Jim and Roy during the game. Michael eventually declares the game over, implying his team won, and jokes about the team having to work on Saturday despite earlier promises of a day off.

main_threads.thread: Michael organizes a basketball game between office and warehouse staff to improve morale, selects the team, and manages the event with various interactions and conflicts.
